title: Frequency's free courses get a public library at /courses and a sales page for The Business of Community 101

source.ref: Owner request 2026-11-17: fan out and build the course library, the BOC sales page, its Funnel and the Space library filter

detail: The courses Frequency teaches (official public Journeys in the Creator Lab category or in the house Space hq) had no public home: the only sales copy lived on the hq Space website. /courses lists them by derived track (lib/courses/tracks.ts: slug rule, then category rule, then Other), each card linking to its sales page or its public /discover/journeys page, never the robots-disallowed /journeys/*. /courses/business-of-community is an EDITABLE_PAGES template rebuilt in the marketing blocks from the hq sales doc, with Course, WebPage, FAQPage and Breadcrumb schema. Both are in the sitemap, llms.txt and llms-full; /courses is linked from the footer Guides list and from /how-to-build-community. Start the course goes to /join?seq=business-of-community; the Funnel row (tag beta_business_of_community, registered here; destination /journeys/the-business-of-community-101) is scripts/seed-boc-funnel.sql, NOT yet applied: until it is, the link runs the default flow. SpacePractices `only` now also matches a journey's category. 2026-11-17 rework (owner: zoom out, meeting models on PULSE, beginner-first, a core training module): the course now teaches four PULSE meetings (the weekly sit-down, the opening, the full night, the money hour), one per week, each week's five lessons named for the five beats, Settle as the body practice, one running example and one number (who came back); Frequency build steps are optional. Three ways in: the course and a live 90-minute workshop on Zoom are free for anyone (the four pilot calls became public HQ events, the pilot circle is retired and unlisted), Business Hours (on PULSE) is for Spaces on the Business plan. Certified is the four-page Community Book only. The Funnel row is applied. Stories for weeks 2 to 4 are the owner's to add (STORY SLOT comments in scripts/seed-frequency-hq-boc.mts). 2026-11-17 pivot (owner: "Remove the self paced course. This is just the workshop run periodically and the Business Hours cohort."): two ways in, the free four-week live workshop run in cohorts (launch cohort Thursdays Jan 7 to 28, 2027, Circle /circles/business-of-community-january-2027) and Business Hours. The Journey stays as the workbook read before each session. Every primary door says Save your seat; the template's still goes to the Funnel, and the Funnel's direct destination moved from the Journey to the Week 1 event /events/business-of-community-pilot-session-1, so the probe now checks for that URL instead of /journeys/the-business-of-community-101 (the course it pointed at no longer exists as a self-paced offer). The December monthly-start Circle is unlisted. 2026-11-18 (owner: one home per course, JRN-017): every card now links to the course's own /courses/<slug> page (the hand-built BOC page stays at /courses/business-of-community), and /discover/journeys/<slug> of a course names that page as canonical. The probe checks the new link and the canonical instead of the /discover/journeys link.

verify.note: Fails on main: there is no /courses, no sales page, no registered Funnel tag. Passes once both pages are advertised, the sales page renders its template with Course schema, and the Funnel and filter are wired.
